label: B25-BOARD-INTERACTION
title: Volatile-configure B25 and prove polling serial interaction
scope: After explicit user authorization, configure only FPGA volatile SRAM with the frozen B25 SOF, release the task-owned programming server, attach the separate JTAG-MPSSE console and prove the BRAM monitor boots and communicates bidirectionally.
validation: Freeze cable/device/SOF hashes, use 15 MHz programming server, stop only the recorded task PID, use JTAG-MPSSE device=1 instance=0 for console, capture exact input/output and retain a known-good volatile rollback path.
acceptance: The same frozen SOF boots from PC=0 at 25 MHz and completes at least one deterministic PING/PONG plus echo session; failures are classified by clock/reset/BRAM/UART/calibration rather than hidden.
resource: Acquire gamepc for all hardware interaction and treat the cable as exclusive. Never overlap Quartus or another JTAG user.
authorization_gate: Satisfied and exercised for volatile SOF configuration plus JTAG-UART interaction; persistent Flash, power and reset actions remain outside scope.

user_authorization.scope: Use nios2-terminal on the already connected JTAG-MPSSE console for receive/transmit testing after dependencies are green.
user_authorization.constraints: This authorizes console attachment and serial interaction only. It does not authorize assembler, quartus_pgm, FPGA reconfiguration, reset, power cycling, JIC/EPCQ/Flash write or erase.

forbidden_regions: unrecorded process termination or broad jtagserver kill
power cycle or persistent configuration unless separately authorized

excluded: unrecorded process termination or broad jtagserver kill
